title: Google Ads for Local Businesses: 2026 Guide

facts.fact: The page says many local businesses start Google Ads campaigns at $15 to $50 per day.
facts.quote: Many local businesses start at $15 to $50 per day.

facts.fact: The page advises using a targeting radius of 5 to 15 miles for shops and clinics, and a wider radius for mobile services.
facts.quote: Use a radius of 5 to 15 miles for shops and clinics, wider for mobile services.

facts.fact: The page's illustrative local budget formula assumes an average job value of $400.
The page's illustrative local budget formula sets a target cost per customer of $80.
In the page's illustrative example, a 40% close rate on calls gives a target cost per call of $32.
facts.quote: Close rate on calls: 40%, so a target cost per call of $32

facts.fact: The page's illustrative example suggests a daily budget of roughly $100 for about three calls a day, or starting at $50 and growing.
facts.quote: Daily budget for about three calls a day: roughly $100, or start at $50 and grow

facts.fact: The page states that Local Services Ads charge per lead instead of per click.
facts.quote: charge per lead instead of per click and appear above regular search ads with a verification badge

facts.fact: The page states that Google ranks local results mainly on relevance, distance and prominence.
facts.quote: Google ranks local results mainly on relevance, distance and prominence

facts.fact: The page was published on September 19, 2026.
